title: Following Digital Breadcrumbs
tagline: Every server, service, and system an organisation runs leaves a public trail. DNS is where that trail lives.
description: Go deep into DNS enumeration — the systematic interrogation of every DNS record type to build a complete picture of a target's internet-facing infrastructure. Learn A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, PTR, and SRV records from scratch. Understand zone transfers, subdomain enumeration, and why DNS reveals far more than just IP addresses.
author: Cyber Learn Team
learningObjectives: Explain what DNS enumeration is and why it reveals more than just IP addresses
Identify and interpret all eight DNS record types: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, PTR, and SRV
Explain what a DNS zone transfer is, why it exists, and what it exposes when misconfigured
Describe subdomain enumeration — what it is, how it is done, and why subdomains are often the most valuable findings
Recognise what each DNS record type reveals about a target's infrastructure in a professional engagement
skills: Querying and interpreting all eight DNS record types using free tools
Identifying what each record type reveals about email infrastructure, cloud providers, and vendor relationships
Recognising the signs of a misconfigured zone transfer and understanding its professional implications
